narrative: Traces a structural parallel between Leibniz's monadology — each indivisible unit containing a complete representation of the universe from its own perspective — and Maldacena's AdS/CFT correspondence, in which every point on a lower-dimensional boundary encodes the entire higher-dimensional interior. The chapter argues that the holographic principle may be the physics of what Leibniz was gesturing at philosophically, with pre-established harmony recast as the consistency of holographic encoding.
